QuestInfo.name: The Star Returns
QuestInfo.0: Blake's reaction is pretty fishy. Did his new guitar really change him? Ask Lana.
QuestInfo.1:
Lana says that she put Blake's new guitar in the #b7th Floor 8th Floor Area D#k to keep it safe. Area D is for authorized personnel only, but #bJune will let you in if you tell him it's to help Blake#k.

#rTip: You can obtain Blake's Memories from [Like the First Time] quest. If you discard the item, however, then you must forfeit Reasoning for Changing quest then start over.

0.0: ...Blake's guitar? Why do you ask? He did buy a very expensive guitar a while back...and then he started being a jerk to everyone... Hm.
0.1: You raise a good point... He started changing little by little ever since he bought that guitar. He became more arrogant, and started to sing a little differently. Do you really think that guitar caused him to change?

yes.0: Maybe we should check that guitar out? He INSISTED that we bring it even though we don't need it at the autograph event. I left it on the #b7th Floor 8th Floor Area D for safe keeping. Just tell June that you're there to help Blake out to get in#k.

no.0: What do you think changed Blake? It seems strange to even discuss it, right?

1.0: W-what do you want now? Didn't I tell you to... Wait, is that...?\r\n#L0##b(You hand him the guitar and his face lights up.)#l\n#k
1.1: T-this is...a signing event? What happened? I... I fell asleep during practice last night.

yes.0: My memories... I remember! This guitar is doing strange things to me. I fall asleep and can't remember things, I get angry while I'm playing, my music changed... This thing is trouble.
yes.1: I promised myself that I wouldn't change after I made my debut, but... I'm so ashamed of myself. How am I going to apologize to Lana, Tina, Marshall, Maestro Rho, and my fans?
yes.2: I also caused you a lot of trouble. I truly am sorry. This will never happen again.
